episode_title: Grok Bot: The 24/7 Autonomous Cloud Employee
topic_overview: xAI's Grok Bot introduces persistent cloud computers that operate 24/7, running multi-step human workflows autonomously via 'Teach-a-Task' and real-time X telemetry.

hook_strategy.archetype: The Trinity Hybrid Nuke (Brown x Kallaway x Ramonov)
hook_strategy.spoken_words: Stop chatting with AI. Grok Bot is not a chatbot.
hook_strategy.visual_action: 0.0s: Pitch black screen shattered by electric red strike-through across ChatGPT prompt box. 0.8s: Sudden hard cut to glowing neon server rack with text 'AUTONOMOUS CLOUD AGENT' pulsing. 1.8s: Quick punch-in zoom on robotic cursor clicking without a user.
hook_strategy.audio_impact: Sub-bass boom (80Hz) at 0.0s -> sharp digital laser slice at strike-through -> quiet high-tension riser.

mode_a_standalone_script: Stop chatting with AI. Grok Bot is not a chatbot. Traditional AI waits for you to type, then dies. Grok Bot gets its own dedicated cloud computer that runs twenty-four-seven. Watch this: with Teach-a-Task, you screen-record your work once. Scraping data, qualifying leads, or debugging code. Grok memorizes every click, closes the browser, and keeps working while your laptop is shut. It's powered by Colossus—the largest GPU cluster on Earth—with direct real-time access to X. This isn't software you talk to. It's an autonomous employee you delegate to. Steal this exact prompt: 'Record this workflow: Scan X for breaking AI news, verify top three sources, draft a summary email, and send to my team every morning at six AM.' Save this video right now, and screenshot this blueprint, before everyone else figures this out. Because tomorrow...

[POINT LEFT AT FLOATING UI] Grok Bot gets its own dedicated cloud computer that runs twenty-four-seven. [HARD CUT TO FULL SCREEN UI] Watch this: with Teach-a-Task, you screen-record your work once. [PIP CIRCLE PRESENTER CORNER] Scraping data, qualifying leads, or debugging code. [SNAP FINGERS] Close your laptop. It keeps working all night. [HOLD UP PHONE / DISPLAY ON-SCREEN CARD] Steal this prompt: 'Record this workflow: Scan X for breaking AI news, verify top three sources, and draft a morning briefing.' bookmark_takeaway.exact_copy_paste_prompt: Record this workflow: Scan X for breaking AI news, verify top three sources, draft a summary email, and send to my team every morning at 6 AM.
free_zero_dollar_software_stack: 1. Grok on X (Free Tier / Existing X Access)
2. Windows Steps Recorder / Free Browser DevTools for initial macro mapping
3. Antigravity & Gemini for prompt refinement and asset synthesis
4. Free CapCut desktop or Web for kinetic typography and auto-captioning

zero_dollar_feasibility: 100% executable with Gemini, Antigravity built-in image generator for visual metaphors, free Chrome browser screen recording (OBS or native Windows Win+Alt+R), and free CapCut or Premiere editing.
